content: विगत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Departed, gone away, disappeared. .²2 Parted, separated. .²3 Dead; विगतं तु विदेशस्थ शृणुयाद्यो ह्यनिर्दशम् <ls>Ms. 5. 75</ls>. .²4 Destitute or devoid of, free from (in <ab>comp.</ab>); विगतमदः. .²5 Lost. .²6 Dark, obscured. .{@-ता@} A girl in love with another (hence unfit for marriage). .{@-तम्@} The flight of birds.
